center_update: only strict fitness improvement replaces a center; cached already-evaluated fitness; no additional objective call
heft_center_policy: center0=HEFT; other3=best nonHEFT initializer candidates, stable tie
hamming_rule: max placement-position plus order-position mismatches divided by2N < sigma
ls_move_family: uniform over available flip/swap families, then uniform legal member
ls_restart: after2N consecutive nonimproving evaluations next candidate is one legal random perturbation of HEFT; accept as current; retain global incumbent
ls_swap: adjacent nodes with no dependency in either direction (transitive reachability checked)
duplicate_policy: every repeated/no-op candidate consumes one evaluation
inference_role: known14DAG development only; descriptive instance means; no confirmatory p-values
